story.title: YouTube tests AI-powered guided search answers for US Premium subscribers
story.summary: YouTube is rolling out a new AI-powered search feature to Premium subscribers in the United States on an opt-in basis, surfacing guided answers directly in search results rather than just video lists. The feature represents Google's push to make YouTube a destination for AI-synthesised information, not just video discovery, competing more directly with AI search tools like Perplexity and ChatGPT Search. The opt-in rollout suggests YouTube is gathering user feedback before a broader release.
